text:
nelson: Heads up — cutover dry run for v2 slices tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need SRE on standby for fallback routing. TL;DR: canary -> 10% traffic, fallback to v1 if error_rate > 1% for 2m. Owners: @devex, @runtime, @sre. Any blockers?

devin: I'll be there. Can we get the playbook link? Also need to confirm kube nodes scaling policy for canary pods.

maria: Playbook: https://go.redwood/playbooks/v2-cutover (internal). FYI autoscaler has a 60s stabilization window; we'll bump min replicas by +1 pre-canary to avoid cold starts.

aj: Quick note — SDK team pushed a header change yesterday. New clients send `x-rw-api: 2`. Older SDKs omit it. Router should tolerate missing header and fall back based on path/query.

nelson: Good catch. @eng-platform can we add router fallback for missing header? Suggestion (very small):
```
if header missing -> inspect query param `version` -> route accordingly
else route by header
```
Keep fallback logic explicit so we don't do heuristics.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: `canary/1767705544-v2-slice-A` — started by nelson.

sam: On metrics: SRE, please expose `router.v2.header_miss` and `router.v2.routed_by_fallback` so we can alert and correlate with errors. Alerting proposal: page if header_miss > 0.5% for 5m.

devin: :thumbsup: I'll add the metrics and an alert rule. ETA EOD.

maria: One more: rollback criteria proposal — 1) 5xx > 0.5% absolute OR 2) latency p95 > 250ms above baseline for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Confirm?

aj: Agree. Also ensure fallback route uses `v2-compat` model variant to tolerate tokenizer/layout differences.

nelson: Owners recap: runtime=devin, platform=maria, sdk=aj, sre=sam. If no blockers we proceed with the dry run. Please tag any PRs with `v2-cutover`.

aj: WIP PR to add header detection in router: https://go.redwood/pr/4123 — tests failing on one edge path, will update shortly.

sam: I'll monitor the canary window in #incidents. Ping me if you want a page or a manual rollback.

linda: Partnerships: I'll notify top partners and post a heads-up in #vendors/partners. Sending email now.

nelson: Thanks — small checklist for tomorrow: 1) bump replicas + autoscaler tweak (platform), 2) router fallback + metrics (runtime/platform), 3) SDK header detection doc + PR (sdk), 4) alerts in pager (sre), 5) partner comms (partnerships). Post any last-minute snags here.

maria: Putting patch into a canary branch now. If anyone wants to rehearse the rollback steps, I can do a quick run-through at 08:30 PT.

devin: I'll join the 08:30 rehearse.

aj: Same.

nelson: Great — closing loop. If anything changes, update the playbook link and tag me. Thanks.
